author: Joseph Mercado
title: Looking for graphic artist for Pokemon/anime apparel
content: Looking for a graphic artist for apparel (hoodies, shirt, etc.) Preferably passionate about Pokemon/anime. Send me a message and portfolio if possible.

author: Sealious Seal
title: LF people who can draw Pokemon (Garchomp & Lucario)
content: LF people who can draw Pokemon. You don’t have to be a Pokemon-centered artist or anything, I just want artists who are willing to draw Pokemon or know how more specifically, Garchomp and Lucario. I usually prefer more anime-esque styles and the OC is cutesy and elegant, but given the Pokemon, I can’t be picky this time around when it comes to the style , place your rates and samples in the comments, NO DMS! This is the OC (credit to Miki Fleur) and she will be wearing more fashionable clothes (similar to Emma from Veil) so please be able to draw those too! MOP: GCash, like always

author: Ash Milite
title: Looking for artist for character art cards for books
content: LOOKING FOR AN ARTIST! I’m looking for an artist to work with one of my author clients on character art cards for multiple books. We have quite a few projects in the works, so I’d love to connect with someone interested in an ongoing working relationship and multiple commissions! Here’s what we’re looking for: - Character art/cards for books - Budget: Under $100 per art piece - Multiple pieces across multiple books - Must be available to start now! - NO AI-GENERATED ART. Human artists only, please! If you’re an artist whose style might be a good fit, please drop your portfolio or commission sheet in the comments, along with your pricing and current availability! If you know an artist who might be interested, please tag them or share this post. We’d love to find someone whose art we can keep coming back to as these projects grow!
